title: Artificial Intelligence Systems for Diagnosis and Clinical Classification of COVID-19
summary: Transfer-learned VGG19 CT classification distinguished COVID-19 from other pneumonia/controls in retrospective cohorts; reported diagnostic AUC 0.95, with a separate clinical-type prediction AUC 0.90. Evidence is limited to the stated retrospective/in-silico/prototype setting.
ai_technology: Transfer-learned VGG19 classifies chest CT images for COVID-19 versus other pneumonia.
organization: Clinical Medical Research Center/Inner Mongolia Key Laboratory of Gene Regulation of the Metabolic Diseases, Inner Mongolia People's Hospital, Hohhot, China

evidence.tested: Transfer-learned VGG19 CT classification distinguished COVID-19 from other pneumonia/controls in retrospective cohorts; reported diagnostic AUC 0.95, with a separate clinical-type prediction AUC 0.90.
evidence.unknown: Methods report 186 COVID-19 patients, 113 other-pneumonia patients and 150 non-pneumonia controls, with fivefold CV. Results link imaging model and clinical laboratory variables to diagnosis/type; retrospective single-region evidence, no prospective utility.
evidence.ai_role: Transfer-learned VGG19 classifies chest CT images for COVID-19 versus other pneumonia.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
